svg.title: Orestes killing Aegisthus, between Clytemnestra and Electra
svg.desc: Line drawing after the 1843 plate of a red-figure stamnos from Vulci by the Copenhagen Painter, formerly Berlin F 2184, now Moscow, Pushkin Museum (Gerhard, Etruskische und kampanische Vasenbilder, Taf. XXIV); cut out and retraced.
